texts: On day 620 of Year 2, the night was clear and warm.
Keepers counted about twenty-eight nightmoths at each lantern of the Cliff Path.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the East Row.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the Middle Row.
The sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowds at the East Row and at the Middle Row.
Keepers counted about ten nightmoths at the East Row at the third watch.
Keepers counted about ten nightmoths at the Middle Row at the third watch.
Tessa Brae collected thirty-five feathers the next morning.
Hesper distilled four vessels of mire-essence that day.

q2_gaps: An approximated cardinal count ("about twenty-eight nightmoths", "about ten nightmoths"): `Cardinality` is specified as a native integer and `CardinalityPhrase` covers only vague quantity words carrying no number, so the hedge has no licensed carrier. The parse borrows the measure-side (ParticleFromNormal 28 2.8) into the Cardinality slot — faithful to the hedge, but the counting-question machinery treats Compute as the hard-integer test and reserves GreaterThan for distributions, so such a count will not threshold.

A container-measure of-phrase ("four vessels of mire-essence"): the genitive section only names the measure of-phrase as an exclusion ("a cup of water") and no section states a positive encoding, so using (Measure <mass> unspecified 4 vessel) with the container noun as the unit is unlicensed-by-silence rather than specified.

A non-Gregorian calendar date ("day 620 of Year 2"): (Day n) is exemplified as day-of-month, so a day-of-year ordinal with no month has no stated convention (and the seeded date-ordering rules key on same-year-month day). This also underwrites the "next morning" increment to (Day 621).
review.notes: Strong parse: copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit on both coordinated predicates, the each-lantern universal as an implication with a shared Keepers constant and a per-lantern Skolem group, multi-word names (cliff_path, east_row) typed by the kind word inside the name with no compound genus, fresh witnesses for repeated bare-plural "Keepers", and the-next-morning/that-day term propagation with its Before atom. The only debatable choice is (Possession $x cliff_path) rather than PartOf for "each lantern of the Cliff Path".
